messages.subject: D-RUG tomorrow, June 8th: converting text to data!
messages.subject_clean: D-RUG tomorrow, June 8th: converting text to data!
messages.body_plain:
Hi all,

Our last D-RUG session of the quarter will be happening from 12 - 2 pm this Thursday. We will start with a mini-workshop about converting text to data with regular expressions in R. The second half of D-RUG will be open work time. As always, you can find us in person (360 Shields Library) or on zoom <https://ucdavis.zoom.us/j/92807937862>.

Hope to see you there!
Your D-RUG Coo[R]dinators
________________________________________________________________
Please remember to post your questions to our Discourse <https://d-rug.discourse.group/> site in advance of attending D-RUG virtually. This helps us do a better job of answering your questions, and also keep a log of the types of questions we see frequently.

For those not familiar with D-RUG, the R Users' Group is a weekly working group to get some help with R-specific coding problems. The coordinators are various and sundry coding connoisseurs, ranging from UCD data scientists to grad students on campus. We meet for 2 hours in an open-forum format, so you can treat D-RUG as a communal, co-working environment: come hang out and chat, work on your own, seek help, make friends. Or, a little bit of everything! Check out our website <https://d-rug.github.io/> for more information.

messages.body_plain:
Hi D-RUGgies!
We are at the end of another school year here at UC Davis, and it is time to celebrate our survival and to say goodbye to some folks who will graduate and move outside of the D-RUG radius. I'd like to have a get-together at Village Pizza in Davis, and hopefully sometime this weekend or next week (I know it is late notice - sorry!)

Here's a whenisgood link. Please select times when you would come and I'll pick from those times. Since I am asking for dates in the very near future, please pick times right away!
D-RUG end-of-year celebration <http://whenisgood.net/8texshj>
whenisgood.net <http://whenisgood.net/8texshj>
 <http://whenisgood.net/8texshj>

Thanks for a great year, and of course I'll hope to see you in an hour and a half for our final mini-workshop this quarter as Liza shows off how to use regular expressions to get data from text.

-Wes

messages.subject: Website making with Rmd + GitHub this Saturday
messages.subject_clean: Website making with Rmd + GitHub this Saturday
messages.body_plain:
Hey folks,

The Mexican Graduate Student Association is sponsoring a workshop this weekend: Creating a website using R Markdown and GitHub. The workshop is this Saturday (June 17) from 9-2 in the Teaching and Learning Complex, 1214. It is a long workshop, but full of lots of good information about getting set up to host a webpage on GitHub (agenda below).

If you are interested, this workshop is open to anyone, just register at the following link:
https://forms.gle/iPUBiLsnZSzd8AAt7.

If you have any questions, feel free to email me at bel...@ucdavis.edu

The agenda is as follows:

9-9:30 Check in on set-up (please try to complete all set-up <https://liza-wood.github.io/make_github_webpage/set-up.html> ahead of time!)

9:30-10:30 GitHub – setting up a project and code workflow

10:30-10:45 Break

10:45-11:30 Rmd – constructing pages for website

11:30-12:30 Website ingredients – turning Rmd into a renderable site

12:30-1:00 Lunch break

1:00-2:00 Rendering – publish the site and refine

--
Liza Wood (she/her)
PhD Candidate | Graduate Group in Ecology
Center for Environmental Policy and Behavior
University of California, Davis
https://liza-wood.github.io/
